hyperedges.label: Checkout, Membership and Order Placement Flow
Verification Stack (backend tests, E2E, CI, fixtures)

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before grep/source reads to get scoped subgraphs; run graphify update after code changes; graph.json diffs expected.

nodes.label: checkout.placeOrder({ quoteId, idempotencyKey })
nodes.rationale: Idempotent COD placement: check existing order before contacting Clerk and again in final transactional mutation; lost-response retries return original order; no partial writes.

nodes.label: checkout.quote (five-minute persisted quote)
nodes.rationale: Quote snapshots cart revision, address/items, verified membership, delivery fee, total; changes or expiry require renewed review.

nodes.label: Guest Cart Merge after Sign-in
nodes.rationale: Additive merge with deduplicated retries; reports unavailable/adjusted items; frontend uses local-storage carts with acknowledged merge to avoid cross-account exposure.

nodes.label: Linear Project: QuickCrate - Grocery Shopping MVP (Dev/ATH)
nodes.norm_label: linear project: quickcrate - grocery shopping mvp (dev/ath)

nodes.label: M1: Schema, Identity, and Authorization
nodes.rationale: Identity derived from auth; admins bootstrapped only via internal operation with explicit Clerk user ID; no first-user promotion.

nodes.label: M2: Catalog, Inventory, and Shopping APIs
nodes.norm_label: m2: catalog, inventory, and shopping apis
nodes.rationale: Cart additions do not reserve stock; unavailable items remain visible with explanation. Carts limited to 100 products, 99 qty each.

nodes.label: M4: Admin APIs and Backend Acceptance
nodes.norm_label: m4: admin apis and backend acceptance
nodes.rationale: Gate: backend tests, type checks, dev integration and approved PR must pass before frontend work.

nodes.label: Order Lifecycle (placed -> confirmed -> packing -> out_for_delivery -> delivered)
nodes.norm_label: order lifecycle (placed -> confirmed -> packing -> out_for_delivery -> delivered)
nodes.rationale: Customers cancel only while placed; admins cancel before dispatch; delivery requires COD collection confirmation; terminal states final; snapshots immutable; exactly-once restocking on cancel.

nodes.label: Tech Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind 4, shadcn/Base UI, Clerk 7, Convex, pnpm
nodes.norm_label: tech stack: next.js 16, react 19, tailwind 4, shadcn/base ui, clerk 7, convex, pnpm

nodes.label: users:bootstrapAdmin internal mutation
nodes.rationale: Admin role only granted via explicit clerkUserId through an internal mutation; never auto-promote first user.

nodes.label: Clerk Webhook Endpoint (/clerk-webhook)
nodes.rationale: Signature verified before writes; delivery IDs stored transactionally; ordering by Clerk update time; deleted-user tombstones block stale restoration; orders retained.

nodes.label: Backend Tests (Vitest + convex-test, convex/*.test.ts)
nodes.rationale: In-memory with Clerk Billing mocked; test-only modules use multi-dot names so Convex bundler skips them.

nodes.label: CI Workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml)
nodes.rationale: E2E job gated by E2E_ENABLED and serialized since runs share the development deployment.

nodes.label: Clerk Webhooks (user + billing events)
nodes.rationale: Billing events trigger authoritative refresh; on Clerk outage return 500 and release delivery ID so retry is processed.

nodes.label: Playwright E2E Journeys (e2e/, @clerk/testing)
nodes.rationale: global.setup.ts refuses non-development Clerk keys; seeds fixtures, creates test users, promotes admin via bootstrapAdmin.

nodes.label: fixtures:seedInternalFixtures / attachFixtureImages
nodes.rationale: Idempotent seeding by slug and SKU; keeps stock unless resetStock passed.

nodes.label: pnpm Scripts (backend, frontend, build, check, test, test:e2e)
nodes.norm_label: pnpm scripts (backend, frontend, build, check, test, test:e2e)

nodes.label: QuickCrate MVP Plan (Backend First, Phase-Based)
nodes.rationale: Backend built and accepted before frontend; correctness prioritized over design; development/test MVP excludes production payments, delivery slots, substitutions, coupons, returns.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules (breaking-change version, read node_modules docs)
nodes.norm_label: next.js agent rules (breaking-change version, read node_modules docs)

nodes.label: Acceptance Guarantees (no duplicate orders, no oversell, data isolation)
nodes.norm_label: acceptance guarantees (no duplicate orders, no oversell, data isolation)

nodes.label: Membership Eligibility Rules (free delivery)
nodes.rationale: Active and canceled-within-paid-period qualify; past-due/incomplete/expired/ended do not; verification outages produce retryable errors rather than silently charging delivery.

nodes.label: Phase-per-PR Git Workflow (codex/phase-N branches)
nodes.rationale: Each milestone M0-M8 gets its own branch and PR; explicit human approval required before merge; no auto-merge or combined phases.

nodes.label: Integer paise and quantities as Convex int64
nodes.norm_label: integer paise and quantities as convex int64
nodes.rationale: Integer money avoids float errors; indexes don't enforce uniqueness or authorization, so write APIs must validate bounds.
